corrections.proposed: 1921 built (log cabin); 1962 replaced with an R-6 cab
corrections.why: The Register and firelookout.com both date the first lookout to 1921. 1962 is the year of the replacement cab.
The sources give a 10 ft concrete base and a cab size but no overall tower height. The 3.0 m figure is about the base height.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says 6 miles east; the survey station description quoted on the Forest Lookouts page says about 5.0 miles east. The story reports both.
The Register places the first lookout atop the mountain; firelookout.com places the present tower one mile south of the summit. The story reports both.
The Register and firelookout.com say 1921. Newspaper notices quoted on the Forest Lookouts page suggest construction ran into 1922. The record's 1962 entry is a replacement, not the first build.

notes_for_editor: Current access and staffing are not verified. The staffing claim comes from an undated firelookout.com page. No rental listing was found for this lookout, and the story does not claim one. Record coordinates match the Register (47.189361, -113.357449). A second coordinate in the record (47.20494, -113.35563) disagrees. The Register's description says 7,796 ft while its elevation field says 7,700 ft (2,347 m); the record's 2347 m is kept. Recommend the Seeley Lake Ranger District confirm access and staffing.
